items.title: Albert Burbank Interview, 1959-03-18
items.q: I remember him, but I remember seeing him, you know, not hearing him much.

ctx.x: Another player is Charlie McCurtis. Do you remember him? Charlie McCurtis?
Charlie McCurtis. I remember him, but I remember seeing him, you know, not hearing him much. Never heard him much. No.

Charlie McCurtis. What were the very first bands you heard when you were a boy, even parade bands and brass bands in the street? Do you remember any parades when you were real young, just a little kid, say maybe six or seven years old?
